record.paper_title: Open Problems in Global Analysis. Structured Foliations and the Information Geometry
record.original_question: Given a differentiable manifold M, determine whether M admits a symplectic structure.

evidence.quote: Smplectic structure in a manifold M

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $M$ be a smooth (differentiable) manifold of even dimension $2n$. A symplectic structure on $M$ is a closed, non-degenerate 2-form $\omega \in \Omega^2(M)$; that is, $d\omega = 0$ and at every point $p \in M$ the bilinear form $\omega_p$ on $T_pM$ is non-degenerate (equivalently, $\omega^n$ is nowhere vanishing). Provide necessary and sufficient conditions, intrinsic to the topology and smooth structure of $M$, under which $M$ admits a symplectic structure. In particular, for a closed manifold $M$ of dimension $2n \geq 6$, decide whether the existence of an almost complex structure on $M$ together with a class $a \in H^2(M;\mathbb{R})$ satisfying $a^n \neq 0$ is sufficient to guarantee the existence of a symplectic form on $M$.
artifact.status_search_result: The existence problem for symplectic structures on closed manifolds remains a central open question. Known necessary conditions are the existence of an almost complex structure and a degree-2 cohomology class with non-vanishing top power; whether these conditions are sufficient is completely open in dimensions $2n \geq 6$. In dimension 4, Seiberg–Witten theory provides further obstructions (e.g., $\mathbb{CP}^2 \# \mathbb{CP}^2 \# \mathbb{CP}^2$ admits no symplectic form), and the problem remains unresolved there as well.

status_evidence.title: Some open questions about symplectic 4-manifolds (Auroux)
status_evidence.snippet: Fundamental questions in symplectic topology are which de Rham cohomology classes are represented by symplectic forms (the existence problem).
status_evidence.claim: The existence problem for symplectic forms is a fundamental open question in symplectic topology.

status_evidence.title: Uniqueness of Symplectic Structures (Salamon)
status_evidence.snippet: Whether these conditions are also sufficient, when M is a closed manifold, is completely open in dimensions 2n ≥ 6.
status_evidence.claim: Sufficiency of the almost-complex plus cohomological conditions for existence of a symplectic structure is open in dimensions at least 6.
